exercise.head:
---- MODULE Counter ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE x
exercise.tail:
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x /\ WF_x(Next)
TypeOK == x \in 0..N
ReachesN == <>(x = N)
====

solution:
Init == x = 0
Next == x < 1 /\ x' = x + 1
